name: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon — Onaga Biography
notes: Official in-game biography accessed through the MKWarehouse preservation mirror. Onaga says an outside force ensnared his soul and expelled him from his host body as Shujinko landed the final blow, leaving him bound to a rune in the Netherrealm; Shinnok later freed him, after which Onaga awoke in his original body.
